hook: One Simple Way To Maintain Your Perfect Smile!
claim: Dentitox Pro is a liquid oral-health supplement with vitamins, minerals and xylitol. Its sales letter is written by 'Marc Hall', a 54-year-old from near Charlotte, North Carolina.
ing_note: The letter also lists phosphorus, potassium and spearmint. Calcium is described as 'micro-encapsulated calcium (MEC)'. Amounts aren't disclosed.
price_note: The letter is inconsistent: it mentions '$49 per bottle' and also 'a 180-day supply for $49 per bottle'. Packages are 2 bottles (+$9.99 shipping), 2+1 bottles and 3+3 bottles with free US shipping; check the actual total at checkout.
checks: Vitamins C and D and calcium matter for teeth and gums, but supplements only help if you're deficient.
Xylitol helps reduce cavity bacteria when used several times a day; a daily drop may not deliver much.
The formula lacks fluoride or hydroxyapatite, the best-supported ingredients for enamel.
No study of Dentitox Pro is cited.
pros: Reasonable nutrient choices for oral health
cons: Confusing pricing in the sales letter
Unlikely to help without a deficiency
verdict: Dentitox Pro is essentially a vitamin drop. It won't hurt most people, but it won't replace fluoride toothpaste, flossing and dental check-ups. If your gums bleed or your teeth are sensitive, see a dentist.
